create_intercepted_flax_module: create an InterceptedFlaxModuleMethod from a Flax module by calling unflaxify_apply with variables and optional rngs
build_penzai_layer_from_flax: build a Penzai layer tree from a flax.linen Module by recursively intercepting and reifying all submodule calls
patch_flax_module_method: patch an InterceptedFlaxModuleMethod to replace a submodule call with custom Penzai layer logic
inspect_flax_scope_data: inspect InterceptedFlaxScopeData to view parameters, variables, and rng_names for a Flax module scope
capture_args_and_kwargs: capture positional and keyword arguments into an ArgsAndKwargs object using the capture class method
